why: The minimum qualifications say "distributed training frameworks (Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, FSDP or Axolotl)", an 'or' list of examples for one ask, so Megatron-LM and FSDP form a group; DeepSpeed leaves it because "Transformers, DeepSpeed, Accelerate" asks for it on its own, and the broad "distributed training" parent stays out.
